# DramaPick

DramaPick is an editorial guide to vertical short dramas on DramaBox, ReelShort, NetShort, SAGABOX, StardustTV and TopShort. Each show page gives a spoiler-free setup, the hook, and an official affiliate watch link. The site is published in English, Spanish, Portuguese and Indonesian.

## Platforms
- DramaBox (https://drama.jinbufenzi.com/platforms/dramabox/): The volume king: revenge, billionaire romance and comeback stories, with new series landing constantly.
- ReelShort (https://drama.jinbufenzi.com/platforms/reelshort/): The best-known short drama app in the US, built around high-emotion vertical dramas and werewolf romance.
- NetShort (https://drama.jinbufenzi.com/platforms/netshort/): A fast-growing challenger mixing romance, fantasy and game-like survival stories.
- SAGABOX (https://drama.jinbufenzi.com/platforms/sagabox/): Werewolf and fated-mate romance specialist; most of its hits revolve around alphas, lunas and second chances.
- StardustTV (https://drama.jinbufenzi.com/platforms/stardusttv/): Fantasy-leaning catalog: immortal kings, hidden heirs and family-underdog stories.
- TopShort (https://drama.jinbufenzi.com/platforms/topshort/): Trending-first catalog that leans into werewolf daddies, secret twins and hidden-identity hooks.

## Shows
- Step on Me I'll Crush You All on DramaBox (https://drama.jinbufenzi.com/shows/step-on-me-i-ll-crush-you-all/): They tried to buy a powerful mother's silence for $2 million. She is about to show them what her family is actually worth.
- The Dragon King's Four Little Heirs on DramaBox (https://drama.jinbufenzi.com/shows/the-dragon-king-s-four-little-heirs/): She saved the Dragon King, vanished, and raised his quadruplets in secret. Now the most powerful man alive is hunting for his heirs.
- The Clerk They Mocked Was a Legendary Spy on DramaBox (https://drama.jinbufenzi.com/shows/the-clerk-they-mocked-was-a-legendary-spy/): The office joke is a legendary spy codenamed Zero. The mafia just kidnapped the wrong man's daughter.
- Move Aside, I'm the True Dragon Awakener on DramaBox (https://drama.jinbufenzi.com/shows/move-aside-i-m-the-true-dragon-awakener/): A servant's daughter stole her name, her title and her dragon. The real Awakener is done hiding.
- Island Game: My CEO's Obsession on DramaBox (https://drama.jinbufenzi.com/shows/island-game-my-ceo-s-obsession/): He sold one masked night to pay his father's debt — and woke the Alpha who turns out to be his new boss.
- Her Secret Lycan King on DramaBox (https://drama.jinbufenzi.com/shows/her-secret-lycan-king/): Exiled by sunrise unless she marries tonight. The stranger she saved says yes — and he is not what he seems.
- The Magicless Archmage and the Iron Grail on DramaBox (https://drama.jinbufenzi.com/shows/the-magicless-archmage-and-the-iron-grail/): Born with zero magic and mocked as a servant — until an ancient grail chooses him over every noble in the academy.
- Escaped from Eight Alphas, Sold Back by My Mate on DramaBox (https://drama.jinbufenzi.com/shows/escaped-from-eight-alphas-sold-back-by-my-mate/): Eight alphas claimed her. She chose one man and built him into an Alpha — and he sold her back.
- The Queen Behind His Throne on ReelShort (https://drama.jinbufenzi.com/shows/the-queen-behind-his-throne/): She built his mafia empire for five years. He humiliated her in public. She withdrew $68 million and disappeared.
- Mask Off on ReelShort (https://drama.jinbufenzi.com/shows/mask-off/): Scholarship girl by day. By night, a masked fighter one win away from the seat everyone wants.
- The Mermaid Princess's Pirate King Husband on ReelShort (https://drama.jinbufenzi.com/shows/the-mermaid-princess-s-pirate-king-husband/): A mermaid princess on the run trades a contract marriage to the Pirate King — the safest monster she could find.
- Love Me or Lose Everything on ReelShort (https://drama.jinbufenzi.com/shows/love-me-or-lose-everything/): He tested her love like a game, and her family paid for it with everything. Now the heir learns what regret costs.
- My Cursed Merman Husband Rules the Deep on ReelShort (https://drama.jinbufenzi.com/shows/my-cursed-merman-husband-rules-the-deep/): Seven brides died on their wedding nights. The eighth just walked in — and the 'disabled monster' duke is hiding fins.
- Craving The Wrong Brother on ReelShort (https://drama.jinbufenzi.com/shows/craving-the-wrong-brother/): Ten years loving her best friend. One crashed wedding later, it is his dangerous older brother she cannot stop thinking about.
- Pay Me Or Lose Me on NetShort (https://drama.jinbufenzi.com/shows/pay-me-or-lose-me/): The ghost-singer died for the star she made famous. Reborn with a system that turns heartthrobs into her medicine, she is collecting what she is owed.
- Every Night with the Hockey Star in My Dreams on NetShort (https://drama.jinbufenzi.com/shows/every-night-with-the-hockey-star-in-my-dreams/): Every night she falls into the hockey captain's dreams. Every morning, he remembers more than he should.
- Death Game: Don't Tell Her He's the King on NetShort (https://drama.jinbufenzi.com/shows/death-game-don-t-tell-her-he-s-the-king/): A broke student, a stolen golden contract, and a 'useless' partner who might be the game's hidden king.
- The Return of the Mech Goddess: Storm's Awakening on NetShort (https://drama.jinbufenzi.com/shows/the-return-of-the-mech-goddess-storm-s-awakening/): The Federation's only SSS-class ace retired for love and funded her fiancé's rise. He chose someone else. Storm is coming back online.
- Live for Us, Alexander the Great on NetShort (https://drama.jinbufenzi.com/shows/live-for-us-alexander-the-great/): A modern doctor saves Alexander the Great in 323 BC — and 2,000 years later the world needs him to do it again.
- My Alpha Killed Me, So I Let His Lover Die on SAGABOX (https://drama.jinbufenzi.com/shows/my-alpha-killed-me-so-i-let-his-lover-die/): Her mate murdered her and their unborn pup for another woman. Reborn at day one, the healer lets his lover die this time.
- The Luna He Gave Away on SAGABOX (https://drama.jinbufenzi.com/shows/the-luna-he-gave-away/): The Alpha King handed his unwanted Luna to his outcast brother. The bond snapped into place the second they met.
- Marrying My Ex's Mafia Brother on SAGABOX (https://drama.jinbufenzi.com/shows/marrying-my-ex-s-mafia-brother/): He announced his engagement to someone else at her birthday solo. She kissed his mafia brother before the cake was cut.
- The Oracle's Awakening: My Ex-Husband Begs for Mercy on SAGABOX (https://drama.jinbufenzi.com/shows/the-oracle-s-awakening-my-ex-husband-begs-for-mercy/): The Sun God threw away his wife — and the secret power quietly holding his whole realm together. Now he is cursed, dying, and begging.
- Claimed by Seven Immortal Kings on StardustTV (https://drama.jinbufenzi.com/shows/claimed-by-seven-immortal-kings/): A night-shift cleaner touches a blood jade and wakes an ancient law — and seven immortal kings sense their lost queen is back.
- One Dollar, One Chance, One Family Saved on StardustTV (https://drama.jinbufenzi.com/shows/one-dollar-one-chance-one-family-saved/): Reborn at eight years old with one coin and a lifetime of regret, he is going to bankrupt every crooked casino that ruined his family.
- The Coffin at the Insurance Gate on StardustTV (https://drama.jinbufenzi.com/shows/the-coffin-at-the-insurance-gate/): The insurer stalled his dead mother's claim with fine print. So he wheeled her coffin to their front gate — and the whole country watched.
- The Mighty Wolf Baby Has an Alpha Daddy on TopShort (https://drama.jinbufenzi.com/shows/the-mighty-wolf-baby-has-an-alpha-daddy/): A five-year-old with secret super-strength crosses the country alone to find her Alpha father — pendant in hand, pack in trouble.
- The Alpha's Secret Twins on TopShort (https://drama.jinbufenzi.com/shows/the-alpha-s-secret-twins/): Twin dragon-phoenix pups born under a Blood Moon: the strong son is named the clan's heir. The daughter they dismissed is the real storm.
